abilities.name: By the Horns
_curatorNotes: Base normals are 3-hit Electro strikes (out-of-Fiery-Passion). Inside Fiery Passion (= nightsoulBlessing), the N input routes to Fiery Passion strikes — separate normal ability gated by state: "nightsoulBlessing".

actionOpensState.plunge (C2-gated): at C2 EVERY plunge opens the 2.33s Apex Drive window, even outside Fiery Passion (gcsim getApexDrive: `Cons < 2 && !HasBlessing → return`). The in-FP entry lives unconditioned on Fiery Passion Strikes.

Charged Attack: 'headbutt then leap' that consumes stamina; in-FP variant (Fiery Passion strikes) costs 0 stamina (gcsim ActionStam returns 0 during skillStatus). chargeFrames.swap=139 reflects ActionSwap from gcsim chargeFrames init; Q/D/J inherit InitAbilSlice default (143) and are omitted (parser falls back to swap, slight under-count of ~4f acceptable).

Plunge frames sourced from highPlungeFrames (gcsim TODO: low_plunge — not measured). Plunging Attack standalone P input requires being airborne; in this character's rotation flow the typical entry is Charged Attack → leap → Plunge (gcsim highPlungeCA path), which the parser handles as `C P`.

Plunge generates 25 Nightsoul points (gcsim generatePlungeNightsoul). At max 40 points and not already in NS, automatically enters Fiery Passion for 15s. This NS-resource path isn't modelled — the only NS entry the schema renders is via Burst.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Gotta try... to do battle like the greatest champion luchadors do! Varesa launches up to 3 strikes, dealing Electro DMG.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to headbutt opponents in front, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG and using the momentum to leap into the air.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon impact. If Varesa is in a combat state upon landing, or if the shockwave from her plunging attack hits an opponent, she will gain 25 Nightsoul points. She enters the Fiery Passion state upon reaching maximum Nightsoul points through this method.

abilities.name: Fiery Passion Strikes
_curatorNotes: In-Fiery-Passion normals (Nightsoul state) — separate normal ability gated by state: "nightsoulBlessing". Hitmarks 17/29/37 (vs base 23/7/33), all Electro. Larger hitboxes per fieryAttackHitboxes.

Fiery Passion charged attack costs 0 stamina (gcsim ActionStam during skillStatus / nightsoulBlessing). chargeFrames sourced from gcsim fieryChargeFrames init (swap=138, N/E/Q/D explicit overrides; ActionCharge unset → defaults to InitAbilSlice 143 = AnimationLength, omitted).

Fiery Passion plunge sourced from gcsim fieryHighPlungeFrames. Each plunge consumes all NS points (gcsim ClearPoints) and exits Nightsoul (exitNS=true). The schema doesn't gate this 'state-ending action' — pressing P inside FP correctly fires the upgraded plunge but the timeline keeps the 15s window open until the natural duration ends, which is incorrect by ~the remaining NS time. ↻ 2026-08-18: "Surfaced via parent burst caveat" was FALSE and is struck — the burst's caveat is the sQ/Apex Drive instruction and says nothing about this; it is also the ONLY caveat in this file, so the divergence currently reaches no reader at all. The primitive it needs is a stance CANCEL — an action that TERMINATES a state rather than opening one — which the parser still lacks (`TokenKind` in utils/tokenizer.ts is a closed union with no terminator; a stance ends only at its authored duration or, when `terminatesOnSwap`, at a swap). Same gap as Ifa's landing, docs/stance-cooldown-round.md. ⚠️ There is no per-VARIANT or per-ACTION caveat channel either (`AbilityVariant` has no `caveat` field and slotCaveats walks ability-shaped hosts only), so the only place this could ever be disclosed is the burst ability's own `caveat`.

Apex Drive entry WIRED (post-P4 transient-state primitive, 2026-07-17; field renamed plungeOpensState → actionOpensState.plunge in the post-P4 #2 generalization): opens the `apexDrive` state for 2.33s (gcsim apexDuration=140f) at the plunge's end. Authored on BOTH normals: this FP kit unconditionally (it only resolves during nightsoulBlessing), and on By the Horns gated {constellation:2} (gcsim getApexDrive: blessing OR C2+). During the window `sQ` resolves the Volcano Kablam burst variant. gcsim does not delete apexState on swap → no terminatesOnSwap.

abilities.name: Riding the Night-Rainbow
_curatorNotes: behavior: "instant" — the Tap form is a forward rush with skillHitmark=5. Hold form (Sudden Onrush) is the alternative entry into Nightsoul Blessing; not authored as a separate variant — the dominant rotation use is Tap, and Hold is a traversal/positioning mode that doesn't fit the timeline cleanly.
charges: 2 — gcsim Init() calls SetNumCharges(action.ActionSkill, 2). Each charge gets the 9s cooldown independently (parser-handled).

Follow-Up Strike (gcsim skillStatus=5s): after E cast, the next N press fires a fast Charged Attack (no stamina cost). Modelled implicitly: in-FP CA already costs 0 stamina; out-of-FP, the 5s window after E enables a stam-free CA via gcsim's special handling. The schema doesn't gate stamina, so this isn't visibly different in the timeline — flag and move on.

Free skill bonus: gcsim sets c.freeSkill=true when entering Nightsoul via plunge, allowing one cooldown-free E press inside FP. Stack-like primitive; not modellable as a charge modifier (the bonus charge is single-use, then gone). Acceptable approximation: the 2 base charges + the natural 9s CD usually cover the rotation use.

A1 Tag-Team Triple Jump: 5s plunge-flat-DMG buff after E cast. Modelled as two buff effects gated on inverse Nightsoul conditions: out-of-FP +50% ATK (constellationScaling +180% at C1, since C1 makes both states deal 180%); in-FP +180% ATK. Both gated on ascension>=1. The 'cancels on plunge ground impact' (gcsim DeleteStatus on a1Cancel) isn't modellable — buff persists for the full 5s in our model.

Hold version not authored: schema lacks a `hE` distinct from `E` for stance-entry behavior change. Pressing hE in the parser will fall through to base E. Acceptable since Sudden Onrush is a movement/positional state.
abilities.description:
With footwork swift as lightning and fierce as thunder, Varesa displays the true spirit of lucha libre, rushing forward a certain distance and dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG to opponents in her path.
After using this Skill, Varesa gains 20 Nightsoul points and gains the "Follow-Up Strike" effect: Varesa has increased interruption resistance during this time, and upon pressing her Normal Attack, she will quickly unleash a Charged Attack that does not consume Stamina. "Follow-Up Strike" will be canceled after Varesa uses a Charged Attack.
She will use different techniques based on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Quickly rush a certain distance forward.

Hold
Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and switches to Sudden Onrush mode.

Has 2 charges. When Varesa enters the Fiery Passion state, she will obtain an additional Tap charge of her Elemental Skill and its DMG will be increased.

abilities.name: Fiery Passion Rush
_curatorNotes: In-Nightsoul skill variant — same input ['E'] gated on state nightsoulBlessing. Hitmark 2 (vs base 5), uses fierySkillFrames (slightly different cancel ladder: AnimationLength 52 vs 43). Same 9s CD and 2 charges as base.

DMG scaling is increased per the description ('and its DMG will be increased') — gcsim uses fieryRush[talent] mults. Multipliers aren't authored (ScalingStat ATK or similar isn't carried on skill abilities; damage flows through cast-time visualization only).
Free skill: when entering NS via plunge, gcsim sets c.freeSkill=true allowing one cooldown-free press of this in-NS variant. Not modelled — same rationale as base entry.
abilities.description: While in Fiery Passion (Nightsoul Blessing), pressing E fires a faster Electro rush variant (hitmark 2 vs 5, slightly extended animation). Same 9s cooldown and 2-charge pool as the base skill.

abilities.name: Guardian Vent!
_curatorNotes: behavior: "stance" + opensState: "nightsoulBlessing" + duration: 15 + terminatesOnSwap: false — Fiery Passion lasts 15s, persists across swap, and ends on NS-point exhaustion (gcsim EnterTimedBlessing(40, 15*60, ...)). The points-drain exit isn't modelled — Nightsoul POINTS are not a tracked resource, so the window always runs its authored 15s. ↻ 2026-08-18: the old parenthetical reason "(windows not gauges)" is retired. There IS a real gauge now (utils/gauge.ts driven from sim/aura.ts), it just holds the ENEMY's elemental aura and never a character's kit resource, so the slogan no longer describes anything. See the FP-plunge note on Fiery Passion Strikes for the exit a stance-cancel primitive would need.
energyCost: 70 (gcsim data_gen burst_energy_cost). cooldown 18 / cooldownStartDelay omitted — gcsim SetCD(burst, 18*60) called immediately at cast (no delay).

Frames: burstHitmark=88f (slash lands). Frames map captures explicit gcsim overrides (ActionSwap=90, Attack=93, Skill=90, Dash=93). Q (ActionBurst) and J (ActionJump) default to InitAbilSlice 122 = AnimationLength; encoded for accuracy. ActionWalk=101 not tracked.
Re-press inside FP: gcsim re-fills NS to 40 points (max) and re-enters via generatePlungeNightsoul. Same 70-energy cost. Frames identical to base burst (no separate variant needed).

Volcano Kablam variant WIRED via the KQM `sQ` token (2026-07-17): gated on the `apexDrive` transient state a plunge opens (see the normals' actionOpensState.plunge); consumesState closes the window at cast (gcsim DeleteStatus at kablamHitmark — modelled at cast start). CD semantics per gcsim varesa.go ActionReady: kablam IS gated by the shared burst CD slot (AvailableCDCharge check) and volcanicKablam() then SetCD(burst, 1*60) — so the variant keeps the default shared-clock behavior with cooldown: 1 (NO bypassesCooldown, unlike Flins Symphony). behavior: instant + duration: 0 override the base stance so sQ neither re-opens nightsoulBlessing nor renders a 15s window. Frames: volcanicFrames=InitAbilSlice(47), ActionAttack=46 ActionSkill=45 ActionDash=43 ActionSwap=42 → J=47 (animLen default). kablamHitmark=42, mult kablam[lvl], AttackTagPlunge (damageTag: plunge), ConsumeEnergyPartial(0, 30). C6 placeholder-buff removal note retained: CR/CD per-ability scoping isn't expressible; the +30 energy effect stays on C6.

C4 Diligent Refinement: when burst is cast OUTSIDE FP and OUTSIDE Apex Drive, Varesa gains a 15s plunge-flat-DMG buff: +500% ATK as flat damage (capped at 20,000). gcsim c4Burst() adds the status; c4FlatBonus() returns min(TotalAtk*5, 20000). Modelled with constellationScaling primitive's cap field (Xianyun-shape). The 'cancel on plunge ground impact' and the 'in-FP/Apex variant: +100% Q DMG' branch are partially modelled — the +100% Q DMG is on the C4 constellation entry as burstDmgBonus +100 gated on (constellation 4) AND (state nightsoulBlessing).

C2 Apex Drive on every plunge: removes the in-FP gate. With C2, plunges always trigger Apex Drive, enabling Volcano Kablam outside FP. ↻ 2026-08-18: this IS modelled, and the "Not modelled (Apex Drive itself isn't modelled)" that used to close the line contradicted the Volcano Kablam note four entries above it in this same array. By the Horns carries `actionOpensState.plunge` = apexDrive / 2.33s gated {constellation: 2}; Fiery Passion Strikes carries the same entry unconditioned; `sQ` resolves the Volcano Kablam variant off that state either way (gcsim getApexDrive: `Cons < 2 && !HasBlessing → return`). Apex Drive has been a real transient state since the post-P4 primitive landed 2026-07-17.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Nothing on screen is wrong, approximate or missing — Apex Drive is a real transient state, `sQ` resolves the Volcano Kablam variant correctly at C0 and C2, and the variant draws its own instant bar with its own cooldown and energy cost. This is notation documentation (how to type a token) plus a kit recap, and the KQM notation reference is where that belongs. ⚠ Varesa DOES have a real unstated divergence — the 15s Fiery Passion pill runs its authored span because Nightsoul points are not tracked — but the caveat does not say that, and I am not authoring new prose this round. Category: kit-explanation.
abilities.description:
Leaps into the air before using the momentum of the drop to unleash a powerful flying kick, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG to opponents — just like those heroes of justice in woven scrolls for kids!
After using this Skill, Varesa's Nightsoul points will be restored to maximum and she will enter the Fiery Passion state.

In the Fiery Passion state, Varesa's Elemental Burst will deal a greater amount of Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG.

Additionally, she will briefly activate Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack while in her Fiery Passion state.

Apex Drive
Increases Varesa's interruption resistance. While affected by Apex Drive, Varesa can ignore her Elemental Burst CD and consume less Energy to use her special Elemental Burst, "Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam": This causes her to use the especially powerful Plunging Attack, the "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," which deals Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon landing before causing her to exit Apex Drive. This DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
Varesa will exit Apex Drive after using her Elemental Skill.

passives.name: Tag-Team Triple Jump!
_curatorNotes: 5s plunge-flat-DMG buff after E cast: +50% ATK out-of-FP (or +180% in-FP / with C1). Modelled as two buff effects on the base skill ability (varesa__skill__riding_the_nightrainbow.effects[]) with inverse-state conditions; constellationScaling on the out-of-FP branch handles C1's +180% upgrade. The cancellation on plunge ground impact (gcsim a1Cancel via DeleteStatus) isn't modellable — buff persists for the full 5s in our model.
passives.description:
After using the Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, Varesa gains "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
During this time, when Varesa uses a Plunging Attack, the shockwave DMG dealt when she hits the ground is increased by 50% of her ATK. If Varesa is in the Fiery Passion state, this ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK instead.

The Rainbow Crash effect will be canceled once a ground impact hits an opponent, or when its duration expires.

passives.name: The Hero Twice-Returned!
_curatorNotes: +35% ATK for 12s on team Nightsoul Burst event. Authored 2026-05-09 with the new onTeamNightsoulBurst trigger (F2C) at the single-stack value. Independent-duration 2-stack accumulation is NOT modelled — gcsim's MultipleRefreshNoRemove queues two parallel 12s timers, max 70% ATK at peak. Renderer treats this as durationType: "refresh" — single bar per NB event, refreshing on subsequent events. Visualises one bar at +35%; doesn't show the +70% peak when 2 NB events land within 12s. Independent-stack-duration semantics deferred (separate primitive).
passives.description: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Varesa's ATK increases by 35% for 12s. Max 2 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.

constellations.name: Undying Passion
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) Tornado plunge (Volcano Kablam plunge variant) → 5s Rainbow Crash buff at +180% ATK regardless of FP state — not authored; (2) C1 makes the out-of-FP A1 buff scale to +180% ATK (matches in-FP value), authored as `constellationScaling` on the base skill's A1 plungeFlatDmg buff (level 1 → ratio 180). The Sudden Onrush -30% NS consumption bonus isn't modelled (resource pool out of scope). ↻ 2026-08-18, TWO corrections to this note. (a) Effect (1)'s old reason — "Volcano Kablam not authored" — is stale: it IS authored, as the burst's `sQ` variant (2026-07-17). The real blocker is that a buff cannot be gated to a VARIANT: `trigger.input` is read only by the stack dispatchers (sim/stacks.ts), never by `collectOnCastEffects`, so an `onCast ability:'burst' input:['sQ']` buff would draw after a plain Q too. ⛔ Don't author it until that gate is read on the buff path. (b) Effect (2) is authored but NOT reachable, so "is wired" over-claimed: `constellationScaling` is read only by the gainStacks amount override and by `tickCapScaling`, and appears nowhere in buffWindows.ts or buffDisplay.ts — at C1 the bar still prints the base 50% ATK ratio. ⚠️ Second hazard on that same pair: the self-buff pool dedupes by `stat` BEFORE conditions are evaluated, and a kit `state` condition returns null (not false) in deriveBuffWindows, so of the skill's two `plungeFlatDmg` effects only the FIRST-authored (out-of-FP) one ever draws — the in-FP 180% tier never does, at any constellation.
Removed prior placeholder damage effect (scaling 180 ATK with manual trigger) — the 180% is a plungeFlatDmg buff value, not a one-shot damage effect.
constellations.description:
The effects of the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" are enhanced:
When performing the Special Plunging Attack "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," Varesa will also gain "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
When "Rainbow Crash" is in effect, Varesa's Plunging Attack ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK, whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" to access the above effect.

Additionally, when Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush mode of her Nightsoul's Blessing, she consumes 30% less Nightsoul points or Phlogiston.

constellations.name: Beyond the Edge of Light
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) Apex Drive triggered on every plunge (not just in-FP) — MODELLED (2026-07-17) via actionOpensState.plunge on By the Horns gated {constellation:2}; (2) +11.5 Energy on plunge ground impact. Modelled as energy effect with onHit ability=plunge trigger; amount authored as 11.5 (schema amount is a number; fractional energy is supported — cf. Dori 2.5). gcsim c2CB fires once per plunge cast (done flag).

A6 rigor 2026-07-12: C2 energy amount corrected 11 → 11.5 (gcsim cons.go AddEnergy "varesa-c2" 11.5 + kit text "restore 11.5 Energy"; prior integer-rounding rationale was incorrect — schema amount field is fractional-capable, cf. Dori 2.5).
constellations.description:
Varesa will enter Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack, regardless of whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not.
When Apex Drive is active, Varesa's interruption resistance will also further increase.
Additionally, Varesa will restore 11.5 Energy when her Plunging Attack ground impact hits an opponent.

constellations.name: Unbowed Resolve
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Guardian Vent! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: The Courage to Press On
_curatorNotes: Two branches: (a) out-of-FP/Apex Q cast → 15s Diligent Refinement (+500% ATK plunge flat, capped 20,000) — modelled on the burst ability via constellationScaling-style buff (see varesa__burst__guardian_vent.effects). (b) in-FP/Apex Q cast → +100% burst DMG. Modelled here as a passive-trigger burstDmgBonus +100 buff gated on (constellation 4) AND (state nightsoulBlessing). gcsim c4 AddAttackMod adds DmgP=1.0 on AttackTagElementalBurst or kablamAbil while in FP/Apex.
Removed prior placeholder damage effect (scaling 500 with manual trigger) — the 500% is a plungeFlatDmg buff with cap, not a one-shot damage effect; authored on the burst ability instead.
constellations.description:
Varesa will receive various buffs based on her state when using her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! If Varesa:
· Has neither Fiery Passion nor Apex Drive active, she will gain Diligent Refinement for 15s, which will increase her Plunging Attack ground impact DMG by 500% of her ATK, with a maximum increase of 20,000 DMG. This effect will be canceled once the ground impact hits an opponent, or if its duration ends.
· If she has either Fiery Passion or Apex Drive active, this instance of her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! deals 100% increased DMG.

constellations.name: Thoughts Floating on the Warm Breeze
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: By the Horns by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: A Hero of Justice's Triumph
_curatorNotes: Three effects: (1) +30 Energy on Apex Drive entry — Apex Drive entry happens on plunge during NS (or with C2, on any plunge); modelled as energy effect with onHit ability=plunge gated on (C6) AND (nightsoulBlessing) for the standard case. (2) +10% CR / +100% CD on plunges and burst — per-ability scoping (gcsim filters to AttackTagElementalBurst or AttackTagPlunge with Durability>0); not modellable cleanly without per-ability buff primitive. Removed prior placeholder critRate/critDmg buffs that would over-apply globally. (3) Hold E or Tap E in Sudden Onrush refills NS to max — resource flow, not modelled.

C2 path (Apex on any plunge regardless of state) means that with C6+C2, the +30 energy could fire on out-of-FP plunges too. Authoring with conditions limited to nightsoulBlessing under-counts — flag for the C2+C6 case.
constellations.description:
Varesa restores 30 Energy when she enters Apex Drive.
Her Plunging Attacks and Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! gain 10% CRIT Rate and 100% CRIT DMG.
Additionally, when Varesa uses the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, or Taps her Elemental Skill while in the Sudden Onrush mode, she will restore Nightsoul points up to her maximum.
